name: Cycles
overview: Cycles the series is about a group of young, black, successful millennials who all moved away from home to build a life for themselves. Although they have built themselves up by graduating college, starting businesses, working successful jobs, their childhood trauma has come back and manifested in their new lives in ways they never imagined. Cycles the series focuses on unlearning negative behaviors and negative cycles and replacing those challenges with positive new healthy ways of living and healing.
